mb.label: Menu
mb.shortcutsText:
Type on a cell — starts editing right away (no Enter needed)
Enter / F2 / double-click — edit the cell
Arrows while typing — save and move
Tab — save and move right
Tab on a gray suggestion — use it
→ at the end of a gray suggestion — fill it in and keep typing
Delete at the end of a gray suggestion — drop it
Escape — cancel the edit
Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V — copy / paste (also a range)
Delete — clear the selected cells

help.payroll_wages_sc: What reaches the employees in the bank: the NET pay, by check or direct deposit. The form asks for the GROSS: at year end, the payroll report (941 or W-3) adds the employee withholding here. If the payroll service charges net pay and taxes in ONE debit, it all goes here and is split at year end (ContaBu doesn't split a transaction). What the owner takes out doesn't go here (line 26: "Do not include amounts paid to yourself"): that is Owner Draw.
help.payroll_wages: What reaches the employees in the bank: the NET pay, by check or direct deposit. intro.title: Run your business from PayPal.
intro.body: For this hackathon we built a portal for small-business owners, managed by their bookkeeper, with PayPal at its center: invoices that customers pay by card and that the owner can dictate from a phone, contractor payments with PayPal Payouts, and every sale booked at gross with its fee apart, with nothing counted twice. We built it on PayPal's APIs and the PayPal Agent Toolkit, with open AI models: the code checks every figure, and the owner confirms before anything is sent. We want PayPal to become the main account of small businesses, where they get paid, invoice and pay, while the bookkeeper keeps their books.

disputes.messagePh: Write to the customer (sent through PayPal)
disputes.acceptConfirm: PayPal will refund {{amount}} to the customer from your PayPal balance and close the dispute. The refund enters your books with the next sync.
disputes.evidence: Upload evidence in PayPal's Resolution Center ↗
disputes.sandboxHint: Simulate what PayPal would do, to test the whole cycle.

outcome.RESOLVED_WITH_PAYOUT: Resolved with a payout from PayPal

err.ai_cap_reached: The daily AI call limit was reached. Try again tomorrow.
err.ai_failed: The AI could not produce a valid summary. Try again.
err.ai_unavailable: The AI is not available right now.
err.dispute_not_actionable: PayPal does not allow that action on this dispute right now. Refresh to see its current state.
err.other: PayPal returned an error. Try again.
err.bad_amount: Enter an amount up to the disputed amount.
err.bad_evidence_file: The file must be a PDF or an image of up to 10 MB.
err.evidence_empty: Add a file or write what it shows.

disputes.offerConfirm: PayPal will offer the customer a refund of {{amount}}. If they accept, PayPal refunds it from your balance and the dispute closes.
disputes.evNotes: What it shows (e.g. signed work order, photos of the finished job)
disputes.evFile: File (PDF or image, up to 10 MB)

evTypes.PROOF_OF_RECEIPT_COPY: Copy of the invoice or receipt

offline.title: Paid outside PayPal
offline.hint: Cash, check or transfer: PayPal marks the invoice paid. ContaBu does not create a sale here; it takes it from the deposit when it reaches your bank, so it is not counted twice.
offline.confirmPay: PayPal will mark this invoice paid by {{method}}. Confirm?
offline.refundHint: You returned {{amount}} by cash, check or transfer. PayPal marks the invoice refunded; the money leaving your bank is recorded as a refund.

console.title: Invoices paid outside PayPal
console.help: The owner recorded these in the portal. ContaBu does not create a sale: it matches the bank row (same amount, {{before}} days before to {{after}} after). If there was only one, it is done; if there are several, choose it here.

offline.amountPh: All that's due (or type a partial amount)
offline.confirmPart: PayPal will record ${{amount}} paid by {{method}} (a partial payment). Confirm?

auto.title: PayPal automatic reminders
auto.hint: PayPal emails the customer on its own for every unpaid invoice. These are rules of your PayPal account, not of one invoice.
auto.errLoad: Could not read the reminders from PayPal.
auto.errSave: PayPal did not accept the change. Try again.

payNow.title: Is the customer paying right now?
payNow.cardHint: The invoice is created without emailing the customer and its PayPal QR code opens here: the customer scans it and pays by card. The sale enters your books on its own.
payNow.paidHint: PayPal records it as paid right away and emails nothing. ContaBu takes the sale from the deposit when it reaches your bank.

profile.title: Your details on the invoice
profile.empty: only the business name — add your address and phone
profile.hint: They appear on every NEW invoice you send through PayPal. Invoices already sent do not change.
profile.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP. It is resized here to PayPal's maximum (250 × 90 px) without distorting it.
profile.logoLocal: Saved. It shows on PayPal's invoice once ContaBu is published (PayPal needs a public address for the image).
profile.logoErr: Could not upload the logo. Try a PNG or JPG.

series.title: Recurring invoices
series.reviewNote: PayPal will create and email an invoice {{every}} to {{email}}, starting {{start}}, {{times}}, {{term}}. Each one shows up in Cobros and its payment enters your books on its own.
series.stopConfirm: Stop this series? PayPal will not create more invoices. Invoices already sent stay as they are.
series.editHint: Applies to the NEXT invoices; those already sent don't change. PayPal has no "pause": to pause, stop the series and create a new one later.

settings.intro: What goes on your invoices and how PayPal reminds your customers. You set these once.
settings.needsPaypal: Connect PayPal (in Accounts or Invoices) to set automatic reminders.

contractors.intro: Pay a helper or subcontractor from your PayPal balance. Once PayPal confirms it, it enters your books on its own as a job cost (contract labor), with PayPal's fee recorded separately.
contractors.name: Name
contractors.emailHint: The money goes to this PayPal account. If they don't have one, PayPal emails them to claim it.
contractors.confirm: PayPal will send {{amount}} from your PayPal balance to {{name}} ({{email}}). PayPal charges you a small fee. This cannot be undone from ContaBu.
contractors.taxNote: Taxes: payments made through PayPal are not reported on your 1099-NEC — PayPal reports them on a 1099-K (IRS instructions for Forms 1099-MISC and 1099-NEC). What you pay a contractor in cash or by check does count toward the $2,000 1099-NEC threshold.

err.insufficient_balance: Your PayPal balance is not enough for this payment.
err.bad_amount: Enter an amount greater than zero (up to $10,000).
err.name_and_email_required: Enter a name and a valid email.
err.other: PayPal returned an error. Try again.
err.has_payments: A contractor with payments cannot be removed: their history needs them. You can edit them.

contractors.editHint: Payments already sent keep the email they went to.

dashboard.intro: Explore your invoices, contractor payments and closed periods: tap a customer, a bar or a slice to filter the whole page. Summary shows your year; this is where you dig in.
dashboard.note: Built with AG Studio. The figures come from ContaBu's own calculations (SQL); the dashboard only adds them up and groups them.

w.months: Income vs. costs by closed month

ai.rules: The assistant reads this dashboard and suggests who to remind. It never sends anything and never calculates: every figure comes from a query on your data. Each answer shows its time and cost.
ai.p1: Who should I remind to pay first, and with what tone?
ai.p2: Which customers paid me the most this year?
ai.p3: How much did I pay each contractor?

tool.reminderCandidates: Who to remind (ordered by the code)

studio.view_schema: AG Studio: read the data fields
studio.execute_query: AG Studio: query the dashboard data

step.checkOk: The code checked {{count}} figure(s) against the data: all found
step.checkBad: The code could not find {{figures}} in the data: the answer was hidden
step.checkNone: The answer has no figures to check

ai.capReached: You reached today's limit of questions to the assistant. The dashboard still works; you can ask again tomorrow.
ai.welcome:
Hi! I read this dashboard and help you collect.
Ask me who to remind first, who your best customers are, or what you spent in a month. I never send anything, and every figure comes from your data.

owes.noneHint: No customer owes you money right now.
